question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill In the blank.

‘Habitual’ may be replaced by '_______'.
solution:
The correct answer is option no. (2) **'Continual.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Habitual"(लगातार किसी कार्य में लगा हुआ)**means something that is done regularly or repeatedly. -** "Continual"(लगातार) **means something that happens frequently or without interruption.
 
• Both words have similar meanings, but "continual" emphasizes the frequency or uninterrupted nature of the action.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Stagnant** means not moving or changing.(**अचल/स्थिर)**
 
• **Temperate** means mild or moderate in temperature or behavior.**(आत्मसंयमी)**
 
• **Holistic** means considering the whole rather than just the parts.**(पूर्णतावादी)**

166:T950,

The correct answer is Option (2) "incessant".</stro
